summary: Pilot-only: compare ET/stability screens by honest GBM RF CV before locking
reasoning: Building on fleet2-vote's provisional screen milestone (cv_auc 0.73 with n_features 20, stability screen + soft vote, step-22): bootstrap-stability screens work on this data. I compare three pilot-only importance-screening procedures (single ET forest top-30; bootstrap ET-frequency k_per=30 at freq>=0.5 cap 30; freq>=0.4 cap 40) under three evaluations: honest (procedure refit inside each outer fold) with GBM tuned on a 16-point grid including max_features subsampling and max_bins, honest with RF (mechanism reference, expect ~0.76), and literal fixed-pilot-screen nested GBM (leaky, printed for reference). Expectation stated in reasoning: at least one screen+GBM procedure reaches honest CV >= 0.70; if none does, I will not score heldout this round and will instead widen the GBM search or change screen family.
